reasoning_content: The `description` parameter keeps getting rejected. I'll just use command and security_risk.

action.command:
docker run --rm -v /tmp/pgrouting-debs:/debs postgis/postgis:17-3.5 sh -c '
cp /debs/pgrouting.deb /tmp/pgr.deb
cp /debs/pgrouting-scripts.deb /tmp/pgrs.deb
dpkg -i /tmp/pgrs.deb /tmp/pgr.deb >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "=== dpkg files for pgrouting ==="
dpkg -L postgresql-17-pgrouting | grep -E "extension"
echo "=== dpkg files for pgrouting-scripts ==="
dpkg -L postgresql-17-pgrouting-scripts | grep -E "extension"
echo "=== postgis extension location ==="
dpkg -L postgresql-17-postgis-3 | grep -E "postgis.control" | head
'
